trango-rock-prodigy-natural.comparison: accepted deviation: reference mesh is a genuinely sculpted shell (16,842 body points per half); native measured approximation drives each contact from its reference hold prim — constant-depth holds extrude mesh-derived XZ footprints; variable rails and outer-supported-pocket loft measured YZ cross-sections so depth tapers with the reference (rail_upper ~20.8→32.2 mm, rail_lower ~10.8→23.2 mm, matching manufacturer 20–33 / 10–24 mm); closed-crimp uses the floor-envelope wedge+tab footprint (not an invented swoosh). compare_exports evidence only per docs/freecad-authoring-migration.md; see .context/trango-natural-cad/trango-rock-prodigy-natural/cross-ref.md
trango-rock-prodigy-natural.supersedesBatch05Audit: docs/source-audits/2026-09-20-hangboards-batch-05-migration/native/trango-rock-prodigy-natural/geometry-verification.json (modelSHA256 b2bdbd9b...) is preserved unmodified as historical record of the retired GLB-import pipeline; Tools/HangboardPackages/tests/test_trango_batch05_model_migration.py no longer parametrizes 'natural'
trango-rock-prodigy-natural.shapeRevision: mesh-derived vector fit, revised: each measured footprint is Chaikin-smoothed and fit with a low-degree Part.BSplineCurve.approximate (C2, DegMax=5, 0.8 mm), then discretized at 0.05 mm and evenly resampled to 120 points. Interpolating every reduced point chased noise into tens of poles (wiggled silhouette + 1.66M-triangle surfaces); the low-degree fit gives mean turning < 8 deg and a few-hundred-triangle prism. The elongated top jug uses a min/max-z envelope (a radial outline degenerates into a bowtie on a 185x12 mm strip) and is inset 1 mm from the top rim so the partition seam does not tear on the shared edge. Protrusions no longer carry a back-plane floor face, so the board back is a single flat surface (no coplanar z-fighting band). Still mesh-derived.
